The package is truncated: retrieval was limited to the highest-ranked candidates and several whole items were omitted because of the byte budget.","claims":[{"id":"claim-1","statement":"The captured guidance lists caring for a severely disabled person, being regularly and substantially engaged in that care, not being gainfully employed, being aged 16 or over, not being in full-time education, and satisfying prescribed residence or presence conditions in Great Britain as entitlement conditions.","evidence":[{"record_id":"https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-dwp/id/page/dmg-vol10-ch60/0003","quote":"The conditions for entitlement are that the claimant


1. is engaged in caring for a severely disabled person for any day1 (see DMG 60035 - 60042) and


2. is regularly and substantially engaged in caring for that person 2 (see DMG 60035 - 60042) and


3. is not gainfully employed3 (see DMG 60051 - 60052) and


4. is aged 16 or over4 (see DMG 60058) and


5. is not in FTE5 (see DMG 60068 - 60081) and


6. satisfies prescribed conditions of residence or presence in GB6 (see DMG Chapter 07 Part 2).","source_url":"https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/69e0fdcbb5e95ca5017ed9da/dmg-Chap-60.pdf#page=3","locator":"PDF page 3"}],"scope_or_qualification":"This is frozen, machine-extracted DMG guidance with applicability unreviewed. 1. the hours spent in caring are not added together and


2. there will only be entitlement to CA if a person spends at least 35 hours a week caring for one of the
severely disabled people and


3. any time spent in caring for the other severely disabled person is not taken into account 1.","source_url":"https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/69e0fdcbb5e95ca5017ed9da/dmg-Chap-60.pdf#page=7","locator":"PDF page 7"}],"scope_or_qualification":"This is a dated multiple-care rule in frozen guidance; current legal applicability has not been established."}],"gaps":["Complete Carer’s Allowance conditions, exclusions, territorial changes, relevant definitions and effective dates are missing or unverified.","The applicable benefit regime, date and territory are unresolved.","The applicable legislation, amendments and cited judgments have not been reconciled; supplied legal records are metadata only.","The meaning of “severely disabled person”, detailed caring test, earnings test, education rules, residence or presence rules, breaks in care and payment restrictions are incomplete in the package.","The question leaves jurisdiction, date, age, education, earnings and the cared-for person’s qualifying benefit unspecified; “citizen” does not establish residence or other legal conditions.","Independent specialist review and evidence-closure review remain outstanding."],"abstentions":["A complete or current-law answer to when a citizen can claim Carer’s Allowance cannot be established from this package.","No conclusion can be made about any individual’s entitlement, underlying entitlement or payment."],"limitations":["This is independent experimental staff-question research based on frozen, unreviewed source extracts.","Lexical matches and project-authored relationships do not establish applicability, completeness or expert approval.","The response does not replace specialist or legal review and provides no award calculation."]}
